layers.2_STATE_OR_TASK: What is happening now, and what you can do — must be clear without layer 3.
layers.3_EDITORIAL: Optional brand line (the family question), italic display, always secondary.

rules: VOICE: CALM, CLEAR, SMART, HUMAN, QUIETLY ASSURED
NO ENUMS, FAMILY IDS OR REGISTRY TERMS IN UI COPY
ONLY DISPLAY REAL VALUES (no placeholder figures; zero bands hidden; HELD and OWED never netted)
THE QUESTION NEVER CARRIES PRIMARY MEANING
note_on_example_values: Figures quoted in proposed_clear_copy come from the seeded QA device (scripts/jurnl/mobile-composition-qa.mjs seedPopulated); the UI renders whatever the device actually holds.
